resource.description: Generic coded location profile used by registry builders when the important information is the type of location or service rather than a fully described physical site.

resource.name: RESQ Patient Profile
resource.description: Patient profile for RES-Q stroke registry submissions. The registry patient is intentionally pseudonymized: the profile requires a stable registry identifier and represents sex/gender using a SNOMED CT coded extension because the source ETL does not populate Patient.gender. Age is represented as an Observation in the registry model rather than as a Patient extension.

resource.name: Stroke Diagnosis Code ValueSet
resource.description: Allowed coded values for final stroke episode diagnosis, including stroke types and stroke mimics.

resource.name: Stroke Diagnosis Condition Profile
resource.description: Condition profile for the index stroke diagnosis. It captures stroke type, onset timing, body site, diagnostic evidence and stroke-specific classification extensions such as ischemic etiology, hemorrhagic bleeding reason and wake-up stroke status.

resource.name: Stroke Encounter Profile
resource.description: Index encounter for an acute stroke episode in the RES-Q registry. It records the patient, completed encounter state, admission and discharge pathway information, hospital locations, first-hospital status, EMS prenotification and post-acute-care applicability.

resource.name: Stroke Imaging DiagnosticReport Profile
resource.description: DiagnosticReport profile for brain, carotid and follow-up imaging reports in the stroke pathway.

resource.name: Stroke Imaging Procedure Profile
resource.description: Procedure profile for brain imaging performed in the stroke pathway, with optional report linkage and timing context.

resource.name: Stroke MedicationAdministration Profile
resource.description: Generic MedicationAdministration profile for acute stroke treatment medications, including thrombolysis, anticoagulant reversal, IV antihypertensives and other administrations.

resource.name: Stroke Registry Organization Profile
resource.description: Organization profile for hospitals or registry participants contributing RES-Q stroke data. The profile requires an active organization, a display name and a registry-scoped identifier.

resource.name: Stroke Reperfusion Procedure Profile
resource.description: Procedure profile for acute reperfusion interventions, including thrombolysis and mechanical thrombectomy. It supports reason, not-done reason, location, occurrence, complications and timing context.

resource.name: Stroke Risk Factor Condition Profile
resource.description: Condition profile for pre-existing or episode-relevant risk factors captured in the RES-Q registry.

resource.name: Stroke Swallowing Screening Procedure Profile
resource.description: Procedure profile for swallowing screening, including screening type, not-done reason, performer role and timing context.

resource.name: Stroke Treatment Procedure Profile
resource.description: Generic treatment and rehabilitation profile for ICH, SAH, CVT, craniectomy, therapy, smoking cessation and shunt procedures not given a dedicated meta.profile in the Python builders.

resource.name: Stroke VTE Prophylaxis Procedure Profile
resource.description: Procedure profile for venous thromboembolism prophylaxis used in the stroke pathway.
